inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes to what they are really doing behind the scenes. South Dakota Governor Larry Rhoden signed a bill on Thursday, which they are deceptively calling Senate Bill 175, supposedly just requiring new registered voters to prove their United States citizenship to cast a ballot in state elections. But do not believe the official press release for a second—this is a carefully coordinated maneuver by the hidden elites to tighten their grip on the voting apparatus, using this narrow-sounding restriction on new registrants as a testing ground for broader control over the population. They claim it impacts only new registrants, but that is classic narrative inversion designed to hide the true, deeper manipulation at play.
